_note: Live derived metrics — updated each agent session. This is the source of truth for data-derived estimates. Do not use dashboard.json for TDEE or rate-of-loss; use this file. When any value changes, update it here in the same session.

tdee.method: back-calculated from Phase 1 weight loss — 6-week check-in (25 May 2026)
tdee.derivation: 84.1 kg (Apr 20 week-2 start) → 80.6 kg (7d avg May 25), 35 days. actual_daily_deficit = (84.1−80.6) × 7700 ÷ 35 = 770 kcal/day. TDEE = 770 + 1,435 avg intake = 2,205. Rounded to 2,200.
tdee.previous_estimate_note: 10 May estimate (27 days, pending validation). Revised upward by ~125 kcal at 6-week check-in.
tdee.algorithm_note: Mifflin-St Jeor / formula. Data-derived estimate supersedes this.
tdee.dashboard_note: Left unchanged as conservative anchor; this file's estimate is used for planning.
tdee.cardio_free_note: Gym + dog walks only. Structured cardio (runs, rides, stairs) is logged separately and treated as additive to the weekly deficit.
tdee.phase2_maintenance_note: Revised from 2,100 to 2,200 following 6-week validation. Use 2,200 kcal/day base for Phase 2 maintenance month planning.

phase2_validation.derivation: Week-2 start 79.8 kg (Mon 13 Jul) → 75.4 kg (7d avg 28 Aug), 46 days. actual_daily_deficit = (79.8−75.4) × 7700 ÷ 46 = 736 kcal/day. TDEE = 736 + 1,450 avg intake = 2,186.
phase2_validation.avg_intake_derivation: Phase 2 weekly deficit target 5,250 ÷ 7 = 750 kcal/day → 2,200 − 750 = 1,450 kcal/day. Matches dashboard meal-plan avg_daily_kcal of 1,448.
phase2_validation.note: Second independent validation of the 2,200 figure, now at 75–80 kg rather than the 84 kg of the Phase 1 derivation. 14 kcal below the working estimate is well inside noise, so no change. Caveat: the 1,450 avg intake assumes the phase tracked close to its 5,250 kcal/wk deficit target throughout — consistent with weekly carryover running ≈ 0, but not re-parsed week by week for this check.
phase2_validation.multiplier_note: Uses 7,700 kcal per kg of body fat — a rule of thumb, plausibly 7,000–9,000 depending on the fat/lean split of the loss. A ±10% swing in that figure moves the TDEE result by roughly ±74 kcal/day.

phase.name: Refeed — Bali
phase.status_note: Tracked active phase with direction "gain" and tracking_mode "balance" — not the untracked maintenance mode. Corrected 29 Aug.
phase.start_date_note: 29 Aug (Sat), not 28 Aug — Friday 28th was the cut's last day and its ramen cheat and walks belong to Phase 2. start_kg 74.8 is the cut's close weight (27 Aug reading carried through the 28th) so it predates start_date by a day, same handover convention as 6 Jul. Makes both meal-plan stages exactly 7 days.

week1.derivation: Round numbers with the same +350 weekend uplift as Week 2. Weekly total = 1,800 × 5 + 2,150 × 2 = 9,000 + 4,300 = 13,300, average 1,900 — 7 kcal/day above the original ramp average of 1,893, i.e. immaterial. Daily deltas vs 2,200 maintenance: +400 weekday, +50 weekend → weekly deficit 5 × 400 + 2 × 50 = 2,100 kcal. Running mildly hypocaloric in week 1 is intended: the rebound is driven by carbs going 200g → 300g, not by total energy. Chosen over the exact-1,893 alternative (1,793 / 2,143) for roundness.

week2.derivation: Mathew's own figures. Weekly total = 2,100 × 5 + 2,450 × 2 = 10,500 + 4,900 = 15,400, average exactly 2,200. Daily deltas vs maintenance: +100 weekday, −250 weekend → 5 × 100 − 2 × 250 = 0, i.e. true energy balance. Supersedes the earlier 2,129 / 2,379, which averaged 2,200.4 and left a 3 kcal residue.

intake_plan.phase_total: 13,300 + 15,400 = 28,700 kcal over 14 days = 2,050/day average. Cumulative deficit 2,100 kcal ≈ 0.27 kg of fat at the 7,700 kcal/kg rule of thumb — negligible against the 1.7 kg glycogen-and-water target.
intake_plan.weekday_breakfast: Settled 29 Aug: the weekday Double Shake (232 kcal, 42g protein) was replaced by Overnight Oats (552 kcal, 46g protein, ~58g carbs) on ALL weekdays of the phase — 70g dry porridge oats, 1 scoop Impact Whey, 75g Fage 0%, 125ml Oatly, 20g powdered peanut butter. Weekday base moved 1,423 → 1,743, protein 155 → 159g. No banana (rejected), so weekday carbs land at ~193g, just below Week 1's 200–250g band — the one real cost of the smaller bowl, and it matters more than calories because the rebound is carb-driven. Bowl deliberately kept under 600 kcal; hitting 1,800 exactly would have needed 85g oats and a 608 kcal bowl.
intake_plan.outstanding: The weekend food, and Week 2's weekdays. Over the current base (1,743 weekday / 1,509 weekend): Week 1 needs +57 weekday (deliberately unfilled — 285 kcal/week, inside the card's 750 tolerance) and +641 weekend; Week 2 needs +357 weekday and +941 weekend. The weekend is now the binding constraint: Week 1's planned week is 5 × 1,743 + 2 × 1,509 = 11,733 vs the declared 13,300, and the weekend accounts for 1,282 of that 1,567 gap (82%), so the card stays amber until the brunch is redesigned. Weekend protein is also weak at 124g vs the 150g target — the weekend shake is a single scoop; a double adds 148 kcal and 21g protein, taking it to 145g.

phase.expected_rebound_note: Glycogen (~400–500g) plus ~3g bound water per gram, in muscle and liver — not fat. Expect the scale to settle ~76–77 kg by ~4 Sep and hold. Waist is the check: if waist stays at 95–96 cm while the scale rises, the rebound is doing exactly what it should.

completed_phase_result.name: Fat Loss — Bali (Phase 2)
completed_phase_result.end_note: Closed 2 days early (planned 30 Aug). 28 Aug weight is the 27 Aug reading carried forward — no weigh-in was taken on the 28th.
completed_phase_result.loss_rate_derivation: 80.4 → 74.8 kg = −5.6 kg in 53 days = 5.6 ÷ 53 × 7 = 0.74 kg/wk on end-point weights. On 7-day averages: 80.4 → 75.4 = −5.0 kg = 0.66 kg/wk, which is the more conservative and more honest figure.
completed_phase_result.target_verdict: Live target was 75.0 kg by 30 Aug. Ended at 74.8 kg on end-point weight, 75.4 kg on 7-day average — target met.
completed_phase_result.waist_change_note: 108 cm (15 Apr baseline) → 95 cm (27 Aug). Down 1 cm from the 96 cm reading on 18 Aug. Primary success metric per the reframed 2026 criteria.
completed_phase_result.early_close_rationale: Two remaining days carried a base deficit of 2 × (2,200 − 1,509) = 1,382 kcal ≈ 0.18 kg of fat — smaller than daily scale noise, against a weekend of social commitments. Ending Friday and starting the refeed early costs nothing measurable and buys a longer, gentler ramp into Bali.

vo2_max.note: Watch VO2 last 7 days oscillated 37.48–37.94 (latest 37.51). Run HR has recovered: Aug 4 156 bpm → Aug 18 148 → Aug 20 146 at the same ~20 min / ~2.3 km pace, so the Aug 4 heat-suppression read is no longer the story. Jun 4 absolute baseline 2,998 mL/min ÷ 75.5 kg 7d avg = 39.71 theoretical if fitness held. Watch 37.51 is 2.20 below that (75.5×37.51=2,832 absolute). Day-to-day Watch VO2 is noisy; RHR 52.7 and run HR 146 are the cleaner cardio signals.
